ATX 3.1 Support & a Durable 12V-2x6 Cable
Includes ATX 3.1 support and a 90-degree 12+4pin (12V-2x6) PCIe 5.1 connector featuring higher electrical durability, lower temperatures, and improved safety.
Certified Efficiency
The MWE II Gold is certified to achieve more than 90% efficiency at typical loads.
Separated Thermal Technologies
Separated thermal technologies provide improved thermal performance and a large, high-quality Japanese capacitor features reduced ripple noise and enhanced reliability.​
Fully Modular Cabling
Modular cabling reduces clutter, increases airflow, and improves overall thermal performance.
